subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` architecture now, and if so must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a generated single-file entrypoint?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup rather than broken behavior, and the current docs, release artifact, tests, and website sync all assume one served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental split only if it generates or preserves one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

options.title: Allow focused extractions only
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract/delete sections only when tied to concrete installer bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental split only if it generates or preserves one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer-specific fixes and helper refactor work make this the best available owner for the proposed split shape.
